title: Water Damage Mitigation Billing Desk Policy on Adjustment Credits
content:
**Billing desk policy — adjustment credits on Water Damage Mitigation jobs**

The job must be in drying complete or invoiced status when an adjustment credit is posted. A billing error credit equals the difference between the amount charged on the line and the amount the tier's rate and the recorded quantity produce; a duplicate line credit equals the full amount of a line that repeats another line of the same code, date and quantity. A billing error or duplicate line credit may be posted only when the customer raises the dispute no later than the dispute window after the final invoice was issued on this job. The dispute window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the job's invoiced date, and a dispute raised on the last day of the window is in time; on a job not yet invoiced the window has not started and the dispute is always in time. Goodwill credits on one job may not exceed the tier's goodwill credit cap in total. A goodwill request above the remaining cap is not credited by the desk and is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy. Each charge line takes at most one adjustment credit, so a line credited for one reason cannot be credited again for another, and late fees are never relieved as goodwill while the underlying balance is still unpaid.

## The dispute window, both sides (hypothetical window of 60 days)
The clock starts from the invoice date recorded on the job, not from the date the customer says the invoice arrived. For an invoice issued on March 3, day 1 of the window is March 4 and day 60 is May 2.
| Dispute raised on | In time? |
|---|---|
| any day before the job is invoiced | yes, the window has not started |
| May 2 (the last day) | yes |
| May 3 | no |

## Credit amounts (hypothetical lines)
- Billing error: a line charged $310.00 where the tier's rate and the recorded quantity produce $286.00 takes a credit of $24.00.
- Duplicate line: a second line of the same code, date and quantity charged $95.00 takes a credit of $95.00.

## Goodwill cap (hypothetical cap of $200.00)
With $150.00 of goodwill already credited on the job, the remaining cap is $50.00. A goodwill request of $40.00 may be credited; a request of $70.00 is above the remaining cap, is not credited by the desk, and is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.
